{
  "sop_id": "SOP-014",
  "title": "Purchase Requests – procurement desk notes",
  "steps": [
    {"step_id": "S1", "name": "Buyer raises ticket and self-assigns", "role": "Executor", "type": "intake"},
    {"step_id": "S2", "name": "Validate item descriptions, quantities, specs, and required-by date", "role": "Executor", "type": "work"},
    {"step_id": "S3", "name": "Look up budget head and cost centre on latest budget report", "role": "Executor", "type": "work"},
    {"step_id": "S4", "name": "Decide how to source it and put a value estimate on it", "role": "Executor", "type": "work"},
    {"step_id": "S5", "name": "Write up the PR note and submit", "role": "Executor", "type": "work"},
    {"step_id": "D1", "name": "Confirm budget availability", "role": "System", "type": "work"},
    {"step_id": "A1", "name": "Incharge review", "role": "Incharge", "type": "approval"},
    {"step_id": "A2", "name": "Lead approval", "role": "Lead", "type": "approval"},
    {"step_id": "A3", "name": "HOD approval (if above 10 lakh rupees)", "role": "HOD", "type": "approval"},
    {"step_id": "R1", "name": "Correct and resubmit (if rejected twice)", "role": "Executor", "type": "rework"},
    {"step_id": "R2", "name": "Lead review (if rejected twice)", "role": "Lead", "type": "approval"}
  ],
  "approvals": [
    {"stage": "Incharge", "condition": "always"},
    {"stage": "Lead", "condition": "always"},
    {"stage": "HOD", "condition": "amount above 10 lakh rupees"}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"dep_id": "D1", "provider": "Finance's budget control team", "item": "budget availability", "parallel_group": "P1"}
  ],
  "rework_reasons": [
    "Wrong quantity",
    "Amount mismatch",
    "Incorrect category",
    "Required document missing"
  ],
  "first_pass_yield_target": 0.9
}
